question: Will the Mets Win 2 or More Games during the 2026 Season?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the New York Mets have recorded 2 or more wins in the 2026 MLB regular season and/or postseason combined, as reported by MLB.com, by the market's settlement time.
- "No": Wins if the New York Mets have recorded fewer than 2 wins across the entire 2026 MLB season (regular season and postseason combined), as reported by MLB.com, by the market's settlement time.

Clarifications:
- "Wins" refers to official game wins counted in MLB standings and records; forfeits or tie games declared null by MLB do not count as wins.
- If the market settles before the 2026 season concludes, only wins recorded up to the settlement time are counted.
